answer_1.quote: We take advantage of the linguistic abilities of LLMs to convert the trees generated by our grammar into posts... We generate a first draft using Vicuna-30B-Uncensored... and refine them using GPT-3.5-Turbo.
answer_1.outputs: Synthetic hate speech and non-hateful posts

answer_4.quote: To validate the use of this data, we recruit a domain expert to assess whether: (1) a post is fluent, (2) the assigned classification label is correct, (3) the associated tree is accurate, and (4) the slot labels are correct.
answer_4.guideline: Domain expert evaluates based on fluency, correctness of classification label, accuracy of tree, and correctness of slot labels.
